actual_title: Order - Launch of the PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana for installation of rooftop solar plants in one crore household with a total financial outlay of Rs. 75,021 crore (administrative approval / Presidential sanction)
actual_issuer: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
effective_date_basis_note: Order p.1 para 1: previous GCRT Phase-II subsumed "effective from the launch of the PM - Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, i.e., 13.02.2024"; CFA applies to applications on/after 13.02.2024. Order date 16.03.2024.
text_layer: mixed: pp.1-3 scanned images with no text layer (pp.2-3 rotated 270deg); pp.4-56 digital text
status_guess: presumed_current: scheme sanction order; later component guidelines (2024-2025) all cite it as the operative sanction. Scheme period to FY 2026-27 (may since have been extended/revised - not checked).
notes: The standalone order PDF was NOT found as a separate file on mnre.gov.in (pmsuryaghar.gov.in returns HTTP 403 from this network). The authentic signed order (Manish Singh Bisht, Scientist-D; IFD concurrence Dy. no. 460 dated 16.03.2024) is embedded as pages 2-3 of the MNRE-published bundle "Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana" (draft CFA guidelines for comments, notice dated 16/04/2024, found via MNRE Past Notices listing). Whole published file saved unmodified; p.1 is the draft-comments OM, pp.4-56 are DRAFT guidelines (not the final 07.06.2024 guidelines). Title/number/date verified visually from page images (no text layer). Claimed title is descriptive; the order subject line reads "Launch of the PM-Surya Ghar...". Number and date match the claim.

actual_title: Clarification in Guidelines for Implementation of PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG: MBY) for the component "CFA to Residential Consumers" (MNRE listing title: Clarification regarding CFA to RWA/GHS cases under PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana)
actual_issuer: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Mission Directorate PM-Surya Ghar
effective_date_basis_note: Date of issue; no separate commencement date stated.
text_layer: ocr: single scanned page, no text layer; content verified visually
status_guess: presumed_current: clarification to the 07.06.2024 residential CFA guidelines; those guidelines were amended 07.07.2025 (not checked for effect on this clarification).
notes: No standalone "Guidelines for CFA to GHS/RWAs" instrument exists. The GHS/RWA CFA slab (Rs 18,000/kWp; Rs 19,800/kWp special category; up to 500 kWp @3 kWp per house) is in clause 5 of the 07.06.2024 residential CFA guidelines (OM 318/17/2024-Grid Connected Rooftop, MNRE file uploads/2024/07/202407021768035484.pdf, not saved here). The only dedicated GHS/RWA instrument is this 19.11.2024 clarification, which allows CFA to developers/promoters against an undertaking to hand over assets to the RWA/GHS. Found via MNRE Past Notices listing.

actual_title: Office Memorandum - Approved Models and Manufacturers of Solar Photovoltaic Modules (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2019: Amendment - reg. (ALMM reforms incl. clause 1.5 Minimum Module Efficiency Thresholds)
actual_issuer: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Grid Solar Power Division
effective_date_basis_note: Date of OM (MNRE listing date 12/05/2023). Cl. 1.5.2: already-enlisted models below the thresholds to be delisted within two years of the OM or at expiry of validity, whichever is earlier.
text_layer: ocr: 4 scanned pages, no text layer; verified visually (p.1 header, p.4 clause 1.5)
status_guess: presumed_superseded (partly): the cl. 1.5.1 thresholds were replaced by OM F.No. 283/28/2023-GRID SOLAR dated 22.03.2024 (technology-wise thresholds, per ALMM Order compilation p.22) and further amended 06.05.2025 (off-grid <200 Wp, ALMM List-I (DRE)). A draft to raise thresholds was issued 28.11.2025.
notes: Date matches claim. Number differs: claimed 283/54/2018-GRID SOLAR is the main ALMM file number cited in the references; this OM is 283/22/2023-GRID SOLAR/Pt. It is a general ALMM amendment (fees, inspection, validity, efficiency), not an efficiency-only order. Clause 1.5.1 (p.4) sets Category I Utility/Grid 20.0%, Category II Rooftop and Solar Pumping 19.5%, Category III Solar Lighting 19.0%. Found via MNRE Past Notices listing.

actual_title: Central Electricity Authority (Technical Standards for Connectivity of the Distributed Generation Resources) Amendment Regulations, 2019
actual_doc_number: No.12/X/STD(CONN)/GM/CEA/2018 (Gazette of India Extraordinary Part III Sec 4, No. 53)
effective_date_basis_note: Reg. 1(2): "They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette"; the Gazette issue is dated Friday, February 8, 2019. Notification dated 6 Feb 2019.
text_layer: digital (bilingual Gazette; Hindi part extracts with garbled glyphs, English part clean)
status_guess: presumed_current: amends the principal 2013 regulations; no repeal found. CEA has a DRAFT "Technical Standards for Connectivity to the Grid Regulations, 2026" out for comments that may eventually replace it.
notes: Claimed "Regulations, 2019" / "CEA/REG-14/2019" are not real. The real 2019 instrument is an AMENDMENT to the 2013 principal regulations (notified 30.09.2013, Gazette 07.10.2013; CEA copy at cea.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/regulations_cpt/2020/09/Legal_Annexure-V.pdf, not saved). The 2019 amendment renames the short title to "...Technical Standards for Connectivity below 33 kilovolts" and adds EV charging and prosumer provisions. Found by web search; linked from the CEA regulation page for this instrument (category "Connectivity of Distributed Generation Resources").
